long_biography.plain_text:
Belgian-born Nadine Maria F. Abrahams has centred much of her life on family, travel and a longstanding connection to Mallorca. A mother of two daughters, she has described time shared with relatives and friends as a priority and treats the people supporting that family life with warmth and respect.

Abrahams has spoken of patience, determination, hard work and good fortune as guiding ideas. Her home life includes dogs, cats and donkeys, reflecting an affection for animals that extends beyond a passing hobby. In discussing her circumstances, she presents good fortune as something to be shared, emphasising gratitude, health and simple kindness over status.
